build.note: Read from saved raw captures; no export, no new capture.

question: Which compiled expression graphs can be read with names, and do any of them set the weapon move-speed input or compute soldier damage?

sourceFacts.method: Captures through frosty-capture.py: expression-graph-sources-2026-10-10 (319 routes: every catalog asset with SimEx in its name that had no compiled body, plus source assets missing for already captured bodies) and expression-graph-bodies-2026-10-10 (256 resource IDs taken from the decoded sources; frosty-capture.py gained --resource-ids-file for this). bulk.py listed every simulation graph and the trait, soldier, weapon-logic, gadget and game-setup graphs with exgraph.py; mkindex.py wrote graph-index.md (imports, soldier variables written and read, constants per graph). Older bodies come from the 1.4.3.0 capture of 23 September.

control.description: Both captures report 0 failures and the build guard passed (client belongs to 1.4.3.5). The reader reproduces the L4016, L4017 and L4018 results.

sourceFacts.floatVariablesWrittenByAnyListedGraph: VaultStartHeight, VaultStartDepth, InputThrottle, InputStrafe, StepSmoothing, AimYaw, ZoomFOV, WeaponMoveSpeedMultiplierOutput, StandSprintTopSpeedMultiplier, SprintStrafeSpeedMultiplier, SprintRecoverTime, SoldierMovementSpeedMultiplier, SPMovementSpeedModifier, HealthNormalized, HallucinationAmount, LastSoldierDamageTime and mask-duration values

inference: WeaponMoveSpeedMultiplierInput and traitsprintspeed are read only by SimEx_RootLayerLogic and written by no listed graph, so the gun sprint factor of about 0.931 (L4016) is set by native code or by a graph not listed here.

SimEx_DamageReceived sets kill flags (HeadShotKill, Killshot_Killed, SoldierWasOneTapped, WasSelfKill, KilledByRailgun), classifies the damage source for HitByAffectors and applies two special affectors (Pathfinder silence for 5, M26 Dragon's Breath by distance). It contains no health, armor or multiplier arithmetic.
simex_bipod_shared and SimEx_GetTweakables are a few instructions each (a channel read and a kill-switch read) and hold no tuning values.
TacticalWeaponMovement, OnGround, JumpAcceleration, StanceTransitionLogic, ProneLogic and CombatDiveAcceleration have no compiled body of their own; they are parts of the root soldier graph.
unresolved: 32 graphs whose layout the reader does not find (mostly tiny or empty graphs).
14 bodies without a captured source asset.
Vehicle, sound, effects and UI graphs were not listed.
Most function hashes are unnamed; listings show them as hashes.
Only a few listings have been read by a person; the index is mechanical.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.
